product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.sum: The high-end TFT Echos in the 1995 German offer.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.his: Computerwoche reported in March 1995 that it was due in April or May at around DM 5,600. BYTE recognised it as a mobile system at CeBIT 1995.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.arc: The TFT was the larger of the two announced screens. Computerwoche specifies 10.4 inches, 8 MB RAM and at least a 540 MB disk.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.ver: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.lim: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.mar: Computerwoche, 24 March 1995, Olivetti will bei PCs an der Spitze bleiben.
product.olivetti-echos-48-color-plus.byt: BYTE, May 1995, CeBIT Special Recognition Awards.
